# R22 regression captures

The four `iw-phy-r22-phy*.txt` files are complete, unchanged iw 6.9 replies from
Debian 13 with mac80211_hwsim. Each contains 35,879 bytes. They came from
`preflight/ceraui-preflight.U2aMjLL4/iw-phy*-info.txt` in the receipt archive
`task-21-22-integ-r22-guest-receipts.tar.gz`, SHA-256
`6e86342c9388fb3eb72925e4d43f7c97125080eedbdd91b3e242520f3e9dc145`.
They include supported 2.4/5/6 GHz bands, the unrepresented S1G band, decimal
MHz, channel restrictions and the shared managed/AP interface group.

These files are input data and are never executed or sourced. Simulated-radio
captures do not establish physical qualification.
